description: A simple PDF viewer MJ PDF is a fast, simply, yet powerful and totally free PDF reader. It pairs a powerful reader with a full library manager, and it respects your privacy. Library * Home screen with Recent, Library and Folders tabs. * Continue reading right where you left off, with a detailed reading history. * Organize with reading statuses (to-read, reading, completed and more). * Browse your device like a file manager, including SD cards. * Search every PDF on your device. Reader * Fast and smooth, with dark mode for the app and the PDF itself. * True full screen with configurable shortcut buttons. * Highlight text, add notes, and save them into the PDF. * Draw handwritten signatures and save them into the PDF as sharp vector strokes. * Fill PDF forms. * Select text with copy, share, web search, translate, and dictionary actions. * Share quotes as images, with the book's name and a choice of themes. * Text Mode: read any PDF like an e-book, with reflow, fonts and themes. * Dual page mode that pairs pages like an open book. * Powerful search with live results and next/previous navigation inside the reader. * Table of contents, user bookmarks, embedded links, and browser-like navigation history. * Right-to-left reading, hide margins, auto-scroll, brightness control, zoom lock. * Open password-protected and online PDFs, share and print. * Incognito mode that saves nothing about what you read. * Backup and restore your settings and reading progress. Permissions and privacy This app does not collect any data. The following permissions are required to provide specific features in the app: * Internet: for opening PDFs through links. * Storage / all-files access: to scan, open and manage the PDFs on your device. Links * Official page: https://mudlej.com/projects/mj-pdf * Source code: https://gitlab.com/mudlej_android/mj_pdf_reader * Issues and requests: https://github.com/mudlej/mj_pdf/ Author * MJ PDF is made by Mudlej (https://mudlej.com). License MJ PDF uses the GPLv3 license.
